title: Not everything in this world feels like something else

additional: Your honor they're very much into each other they're just slow burning it

summary:
It’s thrilling to have someone look at you the way he does, with a reverence so heavy it fills your lungs with each breath. Perhaps one could compare it to a kind of drowning, but not everything in this world necessarily feels like something else.
(On this balcony, the sun bathing him in the orange light that paints Revachol as it begins to turn in for the evening, Kim Kitsuragi wonders if he perhaps would like to be set on fire.)
bookmark_notes: I like the characterisation of Kim here - how he imbibes his thrills, convinces himself he can mete them out, but knows the only person he is testing is himself, knows he can never give them up fully, knows he could only ever indulge under the pretence of control, of moderation
